name: Ahinoam
bio: Ahinoam was from Jezreel, one of David's wives — sharing her name with, but a different woman from, Saul's wife. David married her around the same time he married Abigail (1 Samuel 25:43). She later accompanied David and Abigail when he fled to the Philistine territory under King Achish, living with him at Gath (1 Samuel 27:3). When David returned from marching with Achish, he found Ziklag burned and Ahinoam and Abigail taken captive by Amalekite raiders; David inquired of the LORD, pursued the raiders, and recovered both his wives along with everything else that had been taken (1 Samuel 30:1-19). She later bore David's firstborn son, Amnon, a story told in detail in 2 Samuel.
